ios.desc:
Coin Tracker is a simple and elegant app to keep track of your cryptocurrency portfolio. App provides all major cryptocurrency information in real-time including profit / loss of your portfolio to help making your trading decisions on fingertips.
 
App Features:

- Coin tracker supports all major cryptocurrencies including BTC, ETH, LTC, ZEC, DASH, XRP, XMR, IOT, ADA and many more.

- Selecting a primary currency from Crypto Settings helps currency conversion much easier, app supports all major currencies including USD, CAD, EUR, GBP, AUD, CNY, JPY, SGD, and many more.

- Display current change percentage rate, Total cost, Current value, Realized / Unrealized gains, and prices for your portfolio and individual coins. View values based on your primary currency.

- Stay upto date with all coin information with their current value, market capitalization, circulating supply, volume 24 hours and percentage change in 24 hours.

- Latest News from popular cryptocurrency news sources such as Bitcoin Magazine, CoinDesk, CoinTelegraph, etc. 

- Take snapshots and share your portfolio by tapping on Total Portfolio bar.

- Provide additional layer of security with Touch ID and Passcode for your coin portfolio.

- Export Portfolio as CSV: This feature could be useful with Pro Subscription feature multiple-portfolios for taxing purposes. You could add the same coin with different purchase date within the same portfolio. For example with multiple-portfolios you may track Bitcoin in one portfolio and Ethereum in another portfolio, and later export as CSV.

Pricing:

Coin Tracker is a free application with all above features for the most popular cryptocurrencies. If you are an intermediary or pro cryptocurrency investor looking for more features you would check our in-app purchases.

∆ Unlock Coins: $2.99 One time payment to unlock one ERC-20 token address and 1500+ cryptocurrencies for portfolio tracking, price data, and charts. All existing features will be expanded to full set of cryptocurrencies with this purchase. You can also preview the locked coins list before making the purchase. We would suggest this as a good option for intermediary cryptocurrency investors.

∆ Pro Subscription: Pro cryptocurrency investors would find this option useful with following value additions. Pro subscription costs $4.99 monthly, $49.99 annually. (Prices can vary depending on your country)

- Setup unlimited Price Alerts when a coin goes above or below a threshold value.

- Manage multi
